items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: Jolly Roll Morton played with us. We went there to play with Jolly Roll for two nights.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, I was playing with Jolly Roll Morton's band. Yeah. Well, I was playing with Jolly Roll Morton's band. Oh, you played with Jolly Roll Morton's band? Yeah. Oh, you?

Well, I was playing myself, uh, everybody but, uh, Jolly Roll's band played. Jolly Roll Morton played with us. We went there to play with Jolly Roll for two nights. I see. He'd give a dance out to this place. Uh-huh. He'd run the place. He'd give dances out there all the time. Holidays and all sadness and Sundays. Yeah. And we went down to the play. So when they finished those two nights, Joe said, Well, we're going to New York. Who said that?
